falsifier_requirement.trigger: Trigger if OC does not beat the preregistered comparator, if target fields leak into design, or if the negative control retains advantage.

formula_requirement.formula_or_model: OC continuum-state prediction over disease context, intervention boundary, biomarker axis, threshold shift, and outcome-cycle response.

incumbent_comparator_requirement.baseline_name: condition-intervention historical majority and phase-stratified outcome baseline
incumbent_comparator_requirement.prediction_rule: Predict the held-out outcome direction from condition, intervention class, phase, and historical public outcome frequencies locked before the target slice.
incumbent_comparator_requirement.required_material_margin: OC residual must improve over the phase-stratified baseline by the preregistered material margin under bootstrap uncertainty.

next_escalation: If status is CAPABILITY_DEVELOPMENT_REQUIRED, implement the listed script/flags/model support. If evidence remains negative, preserve fail-closed science and repair the model/comparator rather than flipping PASS.
no_fake_closure_policy: This execution cannot close broad superiority unless the downstream scoring and replay artifacts pass.
pass_predicate: A governed domain scorer script/flags exist, run cleanly, and the downstream domain-scoring report plus oc_prediction_scoring_row become PASS.
repair_strategy: Inspect the existing scorer output, repair the OC model/comparator/residual/materiality implementation, and preserve negative results if OC does not beat the comparator.

required_source_block.source_authority: U.S. National Library of Medicine, ClinicalTrials.gov
required_source_block.source_name: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 studies and reported outcome modules

residual_requirement.superiority_rule: OC must beat the preregistered baseline with positive material margin and no target leakage.

target_variable.extraction_rule: Lock completed interventional trials and hide reported primary outcome direction and biomarker shift fields until the OC scoring pack is preregistered.
target_variable.name: held_out_primary_outcome_effect_direction_and_biomarker_shift
target_variable.unit: directional effect class with reported outcome measure units retained per study

uncertainty_requirement.metric: bootstrap confidence interval over held-out outcome-direction residuals
uncertainty_requirement.rule: Report 95 percent bootstrap intervals and fail closed when intervals cross the materiality threshold.

why_it_failed: The governed domain scorer implementation produced a passing downstream scoring artifact.
